theme_strategy.decision: Toggleable Light and Dark Themes. Platform utilizes an 'Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast' base with specific color shifting to delineate 'Normal Mode' from 'Learn Mode'.
theme_strategy.rationale: High contrast ensures content (video thumbnails) pops out. Shifting the accent color and UI borders visually communicates Learn Mode without completely alienating the user layout.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

learn_mode.description: When Learn Mode is active, override CSS variables in the body to shift to an Organic & Earthy archetype (Focus Emerald/Sage).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces for video cards. Minimize card borders. For headers/nav, use 'Crystal Glass' effect (backdrop-blur-xl with bg-background/80 and 1px delicate inner stroke border-border/50).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders on grids and dividing sections. No heavy drop shadows on video thumbnails, rely on image content and border-radius.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use rounded-xl (12px) for thumbnails and rounded-full for avatars. Buttons should be pill-shaped (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Subtle scale up (scale-105) on thumbnails, opacity shift on text, and explicit color shifts. Video thumbnails should have a dark overlay on hover to reveal play buttons or stats.

component_name.learn_mode_toggle: A prominent, pill-shaped switch in the header that morphs its icon (e.g., from 'Play' to 'Book/Brain') and color (Indigo to Emerald) when toggled.
component_name.video_card: Cardless structure. Direct image container with rounded-xl, flex container below for avatar and text. Clean and dense.
component_name.sidebar: Clean icon + text links. Highlight active state with a soft background pill in the primary color at 10% opacity.
component_name.category_pills: Horizontal scrollable list of pill buttons (rounded-full) for categories.

grids.home_feed: Dense Grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5. Tight gap: gap-y-8 gap-x-4.
grids.watch_page: Asymmetric Grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Player spans col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 or 9. Recommendations span col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 or 3.
grids.clips_feed: Centered, single column snap-scroll container. aspect-[9/16] height-full max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-[800px].

layouts.header: Sticky header (z-50) with Crystal Glass effect. Contains Logo (left), prominent Search bar (center, pill-shaped), and Right actions (Learn Mode Toggle, Create button, Notifications, Avatar).
layouts.main: Sidebar on the left (fixed on desktop, hidden behind hamburger on mobile). Main content area right of the sidebar with generous padding (p-4 md:p-8).

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions. e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. No transition-all.
motion.learn_mode_switch: Animate the background color change on the body when Learn Mode activates to visually enforce the state change.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over thumbnails has a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) to maintain APCA ratio.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='learn-mode-toggle', data-testid='video-card-1', data-testid='search-input').

media.aspect_ratios: Standard videos: aspect-video (16:9). Clips: aspect-[9/16]. Avatars: aspect-square (1:1).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for the core MVP unless used for a creative onboarding/hero experience. Stick to clean 2D UI to maintain video focus.

image_urls.description: Real image URLs mapped to VideoPlatform features. Use these for seeding the UI.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and overlays. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
